title: PocketGull Clinical & Scientific Font Superfamily
subtitle: Optotypically calibrated 1000 UPM vector fonts for EHRs, ICU telemetry & STEM
description: PocketGull (v4.0.0) is an open-source clinical sans-serif, serif, slab, mathematical, upcycled display, and telemetry monospace font superfamily (SIL Open Font License 1.1) engineered on a standardized 1000 UPM em-square. Grounded in Louise Sloan 5:1 optotypic visual acuity standards, ISO 15008 automotive/telemetry ergonomics, and Institute for Safe Medication Practices (ISMP) look-alike character disambiguation (default base-cmap curved clinical l and bilateral serifed I, slashed zero, slashed Z), it includes 41 TrueType (.ttf) and Brotli Q11 WebFont (.woff2) binaries (39 core cuts + 2 circular-economy upcycled display cuts: Botanica v3 living herbarium & Kintsugi v2 -45.8% eco-ink), 16-axis Variable Font (PocketGull-VF), Z-layered anatomical ASL/Sign handshapes, 256 ISO/TR 11548 tactile Braille cells, gapless 600 UPM ICU telemetry box-drawing and sub-cell ECG waveforms, OpenType MATH tables, Scotopic 650nm dark-sky red mode, and UNDRIP sovereign multi-script orthographies.

resources.description: PocketGull Regular (wght 400): Proportional clinical sans-serif with out-of-the-box base-cmap Il1 disambiguation and native fi/fl ligatures.
PocketGull Fineliner (wght 400): Warm 25 UPM felt-marker corner geometry for EHR clinical charts, discharge summaries, and Matplotlib/ggplot2 labels.
PocketGull Bold (wght 700): High-acuity display titling, Bionic reading saccade anchors, and clinical trauma alarms.
PocketGull Mono Regular (Fixed 600 UPM pitch): Gapless ICU telemetry box drawing (U+2500-U+257F), 80-column FITS headers, and sub-cell ECG waveforms.
PocketGull Math (9,870 glyphs, 68 UPM stem weight): ISO/IEC 14496-22 OpenType MATH font for Matplotlib, LaTeX CTAN, and Typst scientific typesetting.
PocketGull ASL (6,821 glyphs): Z-layered 2D Signed Distance Field anatomical manual alphabet and numeral handshapes (A-Z, 0-9) for academic Deaf pedagogy.
PocketGull Variable Font (8,687 glyphs): Full 16-axis gvar + HVAR continuous variable TrueType desktop/server font.
PocketGull Variable WebFont (wght 100-900): Brotli Q11 compressed webfont with zero-CLS metric overrides.
PocketGull Botanica v3 (9,724 glyphs): Upcycled illuminated initials, living Bezier vine arbors, acuminate phyllotaxis leaves, and 6 herbarium specimens.
PocketGull Kintsugi v2 (8,176 glyphs): Avian trabecular biomimicry display cut achieving -45.8% eco-ink conservation.
Cryptographic SHA-256 and Subresource Integrity (SRI SHA-384) manifest for all production TrueType and WOFF2 font binaries.
